notes: The article on the feminine adjective in his wicked way is unrepresented because the suffix licenses the single determiner the ASV writes (rule 41).
his life realizes the object suffix as a whole but heads on the pronoun that directly realizes it (rule 18).

The unit for s027 (hu' -> the same) is an independent pronoun rendered by a demonstrative expression; its note cites rule 41, which governs the article rather than an independent pronoun, but the unit's tokens and heads stand as they are.
